Nypunyam Portal Registration Guidelines:

The Government of Andhra Pradesh, through APSSDC, has introduced the Naipunyam Portal as a single platform for students to access skills, training, career development and employment opportunities.

Why should students register

✅ Build your professional Resume

✅ Explore Skill Training Programmes

✅ Participate in Job Melas & Recruitment Drives

✅ Access Job Opportunities matching your qualifications and skills

✅ Update your Education, Skills & Certifications

✅ Set your Career Preferences and improve your employment prospects

Steps to Register on Naipunyam Portal
